target: Spoiler-free 100% completion: all permanent pickups, endings, challenges, difficulties, replay unlocks, and extra-mode ranks

areas.name: Wrenwood Hotel
areas.location_cue: Inside the compact hotel with a front desk, a lounge/bar, guest rooms, and Room 204 upstairs.
areas.note: Sweep the hotel rooms, reception side room, and upstairs recreation room before using the obvious room interaction.

save_backup.title: Back up your save now
save_backup.why: Something in this hotel can permanently close the area. Make a separate save before using the central room interaction.
save_backup.detail: Do the sweep first; use the backup only if the per-area count is short.

point_of_no_return.title: Point of no return ahead
point_of_no_return.why: Inspecting the bed in Room 204 moves you out of this hotel section.
point_of_no_return.detail: Finish all visible desk, drawer, wall-map, and upstairs-room pickups first.

levels.1: Start by checking what is already in your inventory.
levels.2: The Investigation Report is already in your inventory when the game begins; open it from the Items menu.
levels.3: The Investigation Report starts in your inventory; open it from Items, then zoom and rotate it until the photo protruding from the folder becomes interactive, inspect the photo, and read the report.

levels.1: Along the opening street, pay attention to public information displays.
levels.2: On the opening street, interact with the city map on the right side to read the Wrenwood City Guide.
levels.3: Inspect the city map on the right side of the opening street and read the guide entry before continuing beyond this stretch.

levels.1: After passing through the kitchen, inspect objects carefully in the dark rooms ahead.
levels.2: Beyond the kitchen, enter the unlit Lounge and Bar, turn over the photograph fixed to the counter, and inspect its reverse.
levels.3: Use the flashlight in the dark Lounge and Bar, interact with the photo taped to the bar, then rotate it and inspect the back to take the Old Key; the map also becomes available in this section.

levels.1: Once the first locked route opens, check the floor near the next staircase.
levels.2: Use the Old Key, enter the room with the stairs, and collect the Hotel Pamphlet from the floor ahead.
levels.3: Unlock the door with the Old Key, proceed into the room with the staircase, and pick up the pamphlet from the floor before going upstairs.

levels.1: Reception has a small back office worth searching before you move on.
levels.2: Go behind the reception desk, follow the passage into the back office, and open the blue drawer.
levels.3: From the lobby, circle behind reception and follow the route into its back office, then open the blue drawer and read the Notice of Closure.

levels.1: The reception office contains more than one useful find.
levels.2: Collect the Wrenwood Hotel Map from the wall in the office behind reception.
levels.3: After opening the blue drawer in the office behind reception, inspect the wall in the same room and take the hotel map before leaving.

levels.1: On the upper floor, give the recreational rooms a thorough sweep.
levels.2: In the second-floor Rec Room, collect the Wire Cutters from the pool table.
levels.3: Reach the second-floor Rec Room, approach the pool table, and take the Wire Cutters before returning to any chained route.

levels.1: A required interaction downstairs registers a file automatically.
levels.2: Examine the painting downstairs to have Alyssa's Journal added automatically.
levels.3: Interact with the downstairs painting and continue until Alyssa's Journal appears in your Files; there is no separate document to pick up.

levels.1: The same required downstairs sequence also provides a key automatically.
levels.2: Continue after examining the downstairs painting; the Emergency Exit Key is added automatically just after the journal.
levels.3: Complete the required interaction with the downstairs painting and wait for both the journal and Emergency Exit Key to register; no manual pickup is required.

levels.1: An early report contains a familiar municipal surname.
levels.2: Read the Investigation Report closely and inspect the abbreviated name in its list.
levels.3: Open the Investigation Report and find M. Warren. The name points back to Raccoon City's former mayor in an earlier entry.

areas.name: Main Street
areas.location_cue: On the short outdoor street stretch with shopfronts, side pavement, and a highway crossing at the far end.
areas.note: A brief outdoor section. Check the street-facing surfaces before crossing the highway.

save_backup.title: Back up your save now
save_backup.why: Crossing ahead permanently moves this short section on. Back up before you cross if the current-area count is not clear.
save_backup.detail: The safest moment is before stepping into the highway crossing.

point_of_no_return.title: Point of no return ahead
point_of_no_return.why: Crossing the highway ends this street section.
point_of_no_return.detail: Do not cross until this area is clear.

levels.1: No searching is needed for the file in this short street section.
levels.2: Continue along Main Street until the Report on Victor Gideon is added automatically.
levels.3: Proceed through the Main Street section and check the Files menu once the report registers; it is automatic and has no physical pickup.

levels.1: Watch the vehicle details during the roadside sequence.
levels.2: Read the plate on the car shown along the early road.
levels.3: Pause or use the model viewer if needed and read ND-9642 on the plate; its digits collect the numbered entries in which this driver is playable.

levels.1: A roadside business reuses a recognizable company name.
levels.2: Look at the gas-station branding during the drive toward the city.
levels.3: Watch the roadside forecourt and identify its Mizoil sign. The location recalls the gas-station setting used in an earlier Raccoon City game.

areas.name: Care Center - Patient Rooms
areas.location_cue: When control resumes inside the medical building around Room 203, Room 202, Room 201, and the nearby nurse station.
areas.note: This opening wing has one easy-to-miss coin and several small room pickups.

save_backup.title: Back up your save now
save_backup.why: One nearby action closes this first medical-building segment. Back up before placing a repaired part into the locked gate.
save_backup.detail: Clear Room 203, Room 202, Room 201, and the nurse station before using the part.

point_of_no_return.title: Point of no return ahead
point_of_no_return.why: Placing the Fuse at the locked gate moves you out of this first patient-room section.
point_of_no_return.detail: The cart/locker pickup in the nurse station is especially easy to miss.

levels.1: At the start of this section, check the small furniture before leaving the room.
levels.2: Collect the Progress Notes from the small table in Room 203.
levels.3: Before leaving Room 203, inspect the small table in the room and read the Progress Notes.

levels.1: Near an early locked gate, search the surrounding storage carefully.
levels.2: Open the drawer beside the locked gate and its fuse box to collect the Cherub Key.
levels.3: At the locked gate with the adjacent fuse box, open the nearby drawer and take the Cherub Key; use it to unlock Room 201.

levels.1: Once a numbered room is unlocked, inspect the area around its electrical panel.
levels.2: Unlock Room 201 with the Cherub Key and collect the Lighter beside the green fuse box.
levels.3: Use the Cherub Key on Room 201, enter, and take the Lighter positioned next to the green fuse box before leaving.

levels.1: One nearby numbered room has a closet worth opening.
levels.2: Enter Room 202 and read the Note on Cardboard Box inside the closet.
levels.3: Open the closet in Room 202, inspect the cardboard box inside, and read the note before moving on.

levels.1: A movable cart can help you reach more than one side of the Nurses' Station.
levels.2: Before moving the cart to the right, climb it on the left side of the Nurses' Station and collect the coin from atop the locker.
levels.3: In the Nurses' Station, climb the cart while it is still on the left and take the coin from the top of the locker; collect it before pushing the cart right, where it is needed for the next pickup.

levels.1: After using the cart on one side, reposition it and look higher.
levels.2: Move the cart to the right side of the Nurses' Station, climb it, and open the toolbox on the shelf.
levels.3: After collecting the coin from the left side, push the cart to the right, climb up, and take the Screwdriver from the toolbox on the shelf.

levels.1: A previously visited room contains a panel that can now be opened.
levels.2: Return to Room 201 and use the Screwdriver to open the fuse box and take the Fuse.
levels.3: Use the Cherub Key to access Room 201 if needed, open its fuse box with the Screwdriver, take the Fuse, then install it at the locked gate.

areas.name: Care Center - Rehabilitation Ward
areas.location_cue: Inside the therapy/rehabilitation wing, with a fireplace visible after the cut-open door route.
areas.note: Short combat-forward wing. Listen and look before leaving the ward.

save_backup.title: Back up your save now
save_backup.why: This ward is brief and one pickup can be missed once you advance. Back up before leaving the ward route.
save_backup.detail: If the per-area count is not complete, reload before continuing.

point_of_no_return.title: Point of no return ahead
point_of_no_return.why: Progressing through the ward ends this short section.
point_of_no_return.detail: Check the fireplace area before moving on.

levels.1: After opening the chained route, listen for a moving figure in the next interior.
levels.2: Beyond the chainsaw-cut door, go through the next doorway and find the figure on the fireplace directly ahead.
levels.3: Cut through the chained door, enter the following room, and destroy the moving, noise-making figure on the fireplace in front of you.

areas.name: Care Center - Main Building
areas.location_cue: The large multi-floor medical building hub with the central hall, west/east wings, parlor, offices, kitchen, garage, and lab rooms.
areas.note: Large hub section. Many collectibles are behind keycard tiers and room returns, so keep manual saves in separate slots.

save_backup.title: Back up your save now
save_backup.why: This hub contains many permanent missables and several locked-room returns. Back up before every major keycard/puzzle handoff and before leaving the hub route.
save_backup.detail: Use separate manual slots; do not overwrite your earliest hub backup until the guide has moved past the building.

point_of_no_return.title: Point of no return ahead
point_of_no_return.why: After the level-3 access route is resolved, you are pushed into a lower section and cannot freely continue this same sweep.
point_of_no_return.detail: Before that handoff, finish parlor lockers, west/east wing rooms, safes, coins, files, charms, and the level-3 side room.

levels.1: The first downstairs safe room has several surfaces worth checking.
levels.2: Go downstairs to the Guard Office safe room and collect the coin from the desk.
levels.3: Enter the downstairs Guard Office safe room, inspect the desk, and take the coin before leaving through the red-lit route.

levels.1: The downstairs safe room holds more than one document.
levels.2: In the Guard Office safe room, read the Care Center Pamphlet on the table by the couch.
levels.3: After entering the Guard Office safe room downstairs, inspect the couch table and read the pamphlet before moving on.

levels.1: Before leaving the downstairs safe room, inspect its wall displays.
levels.2: In the Guard Office safe room, read the writing on the wall-mounted whiteboard near the exit.
levels.3: Cross the Guard Office toward its exit and interact with the whiteboard on the wall to register the Whiteboard Scrawl.

levels.1: The route beyond the safe room provides access to another wing.
levels.2: Go through the red-lit door in the Guard Office to receive the West Wing Keycard automatically.
levels.3: Take the red-lit route from the Guard Office and continue until the West Wing Keycard registers automatically, then use it on the West Wing door in Central Hall.

levels.1: After passing through the kitchen, check the floor in the next large room.
levels.2: Enter the Dining Room through the Kitchen and collect the B934 pistol from the floor.
levels.3: Follow the route through the Kitchen into the Dining Room, then pick up the B934 from the floor before searching the room's shelves.

levels.1: A seemingly ordinary container in the Dining Room is worth keeping for much later.
levels.2: In the Dining Room, look behind the table on the left and take the Empty Bottle from the shelf.
levels.3: Collect the Empty Bottle from the shelf behind the left-side Dining Room table, then keep it in your inventory or storage box; do not discard it, because a later optional completion step requires it.

levels.1: The rooms adjoining the Dining Room contain another useful weapon.
levels.2: Open the locker in the Filing Room next to the Dining Room to collect the Makeshift Knife.
levels.3: Enter the Filing Room beside the Dining Room, open its locker, and take the Makeshift Knife before continuing north.

levels.1: Watch what nearby enemies are carrying around the Dining and Filing Rooms.
levels.2: Defeat the knife-wielding enemy near the Dining Room and Filing Room, then collect the dropped Hunting Knife.
levels.3: Find the enemy visibly carrying a knife near the Dining and Filing Rooms, defeat it, and pick up the Hunting Knife it drops before leaving the area.

levels.1: Check the connecting corridors after searching the Filing Room.
levels.2: Collect the coin in the corridor directly north of the Filing Room.
levels.3: Leave the Filing Room by the northern route, search the connecting corridor, and pick up the coin before climbing farther into the West Wing.

levels.1: Early on the upper route, inspect the walls around the stairs.
levels.2: After climbing the first set of West Wing stairs, collect the map from the wall.
levels.3: Take the first staircase in the West Wing and inspect the wall at the top to collect the West Wing Map before proceeding.

levels.1: In the lounge, inspect the musical furnishings as well as the bar.
levels.2: Collect the coin from the piano in the Bar and Lounge.
levels.3: Enter the Bar and Lounge, approach the piano, and take the coin resting on it before dealing with the locked safe.

levels.1: One distinctive enemy in the lounge carries a collectible.
levels.2: Defeat the singing enemy in the white dress in the Bar and Lounge and collect the coin it drops.
levels.3: Locate the singing, white-dressed enemy in the Bar and Lounge, defeat it, and pick up the dropped coin before leaving the room.

levels.1: A locked container is sitting in plain view around the lounge's serving area.
levels.2: Find the safe on the bar counter in the Bar and Lounge, behind the enemies.
levels.3: Open the bar-counter safe with Left 10, Right 80, Left 30 on Casual/Standard or Right 20, Left 50, Right 30 on Insanity; it contains three Antique Coins, and the later code file is not required.

levels.1: A lounge safe contains a small group of collectibles.
levels.2: This is one of the three coins inside the safe on the Bar and Lounge counter.
levels.3: Open the bar-counter safe with Left 10, Right 80, Left 30 on Casual/Standard or Right 20, Left 50, Right 30 on Insanity, then collect all three coins inside; this entry is one of them.

levels.1: A lounge safe contains a small group of collectibles.
levels.2: This is one of the three coins inside the safe on the Bar and Lounge counter.
levels.3: Open the bar-counter safe with Left 10, Right 80, Left 30 on Casual/Standard or Right 20, Left 50, Right 30 on Insanity, then collect all three coins inside; this entry is one of them.

levels.1: A lounge safe contains a small group of collectibles.
levels.2: This is one of the three coins inside the safe on the Bar and Lounge counter.
levels.3: Open the bar-counter safe with Left 10, Right 80, Left 30 on Casual/Standard or Right 20, Left 50, Right 30 on Insanity, then collect all three coins inside; this entry is one of them.

levels.1: The lounge bar holds another useful pickup in the open.
levels.2: Collect the S&S M232 from the bar counter in the Bar and Lounge.
levels.3: After clearing a path through the Bar and Lounge, approach the bar counter and take the S&S M232 before entering the next corridor.

levels.1: After leaving the lounge, inspect clothing and fixtures along the corridor.
levels.2: Continue past the Bar and Lounge, take the corridor's left turn, and search the wall-hung white coat.
levels.3: From the Bar and Lounge, follow the corridor and take the left turn, then interact with the hanging white coat to retrieve and read the Folded Note.

levels.1: A dark office contains a key item tucked into one of its corners.
levels.2: In the Chairman's Office, collect the Red Jewel from the Unicorn Trinket Box in the left corner; on Insanity, check the rear room instead.
levels.3: Search the left corner of the dark Chairman's Office for the Unicorn Trinket Box and take the Red Jewel; on Insanity, the box is moved into the office's rear room.

items.label: File #12 - Copy of an Email to a Manager

levels.1: The dark office contains a document on its storage furniture.
levels.2: In the Chairman's Office, read the Copy of an Email to a Manager on the cupboard.
levels.3: Before leaving the Chairman's Office, inspect the cupboard in the main room and read the email copy.

levels.1: Do not overlook the waste container in the office's rear room.
levels.2: Enter the rear room of the Chairman's Office and retrieve the Note to a Chairman from the trash bin.
levels.3: Search the back room of the Chairman's Office, interact with the trash bin, and read the note hidden inside.

levels.1: One ordinary object on the office furniture is needed for a nearby interaction.
levels.2: Collect the Pencil from the table in the Chairman's Office.
levels.3: Take the Pencil from the Chairman's Office table, keep it in your inventory, and use it on the unfinished note in the same office.

levels.1: An unfinished document in the office can be completed with a nearby item.
levels.2: Use the Pencil to shade the unfinished note in the Chairman's Office and receive the completed file.
levels.3: Collect the Pencil from the office table, interact with the unfinished note, and choose to shade it; the Chairman's Note is then added as a file.

levels.1: The same office contains a symbol puzzle guarding a key item.
levels.2: Interact with the puzzle safe in the Chairman's Office to obtain the Moon Quartz.
levels.3: Enter Moon, Sun, Star, Moon on the Chairman's Office puzzle safe, take the Moon Quartz, then use it on the Quartz Door in Central Hall.

levels.1: A previously locked room downstairs becomes worth revisiting once you have a jewel.
levels.2: Use the Red Jewel on the Parlor door downstairs, then collect the coin from the roulette table.
levels.3: Backtrack downstairs through the West Wing, insert the Red Jewel into the Parlor door, and take the coin from the roulette table inside.

levels.1: The newly opened Parlor has more than one coin in its serving area.
levels.2: Collect the coin from the bar counter inside the Parlor.
levels.3: After opening the Parlor with the Red Jewel, inspect its bar counter and take the coin resting in the open.

levels.1: One Parlor collectible is concealed in a breakable object.
levels.2: Behind the Parlor counter, destroy the porcelain container beside the previous coin.
levels.3: Go behind the Parlor bar counter near Antique Coin #10, break the porcelain container, and collect the coin revealed inside.

levels.1: Search the rear corners of the newly opened Parlor carefully.
levels.2: Search the Parlor's rear-left corner and examine the severed arm to obtain the East Wing Keycard.
levels.3: Unlock the Parlor with the Red Jewel, go to its back-left corner, and inspect the severed arm closely to retrieve the East Wing Keycard.

levels.1: The coin-operated lockers in the Parlor offer permanent upgrades.
levels.2: Spend three Antique Coins on the Parlor locker containing the Hip Pouch.
levels.3: Open the 3-coin Parlor locker to obtain the Hip Pouch; all four lockers cost 17 coins total, so buy what you can now and return later, while Insanity changes the full lineup to Hip Pouch, 30 Handgun Ammo, RIP Knife, and Override Manual.

levels.1: The coin-operated lockers in the Parlor offer permanent upgrades.
levels.2: Spend four Antique Coins on the Parlor locker containing the Stabilizer.
levels.3: Open the 4-coin Parlor locker for the Stabilizer; all four lockers cost 17 coins total, so return after finding more, while Insanity changes the full lineup to Hip Pouch, 30 Handgun Ammo, RIP Knife, and Override Manual.

levels.1: The coin-operated lockers in the Parlor offer permanent upgrades.
levels.2: Spend four Antique Coins on the Parlor locker containing the Steroids.
levels.3: Open the other 4-coin Parlor locker for the Steroids; all four lockers cost 17 coins total, so return after finding more, while Insanity changes the full lineup to Hip Pouch, 30 Handgun Ammo, RIP Knife, and Override Manual.

levels.1: The coin-operated lockers in the Parlor offer permanent upgrades.
levels.2: Spend six Antique Coins on the Parlor locker containing the Override Manual.
levels.3: Open the 6-coin Parlor locker for the Override Manual; all four lockers cost 17 coins total, so return after finding more, while Insanity changes the full lineup to Hip Pouch, 30 Handgun Ammo, RIP Knife, and Override Manual.

levels.1: A large enemy on the kitchen route carries access to a nearby side room.
levels.2: Defeat the large enemy in the Kitchen, collect the dropped Pantry Key, and use it on the pantry door.
levels.3: Defeat the large Kitchen enemy, make sure you pick up the Pantry Key it drops, then unlock the pantry door before leaving this wing.

levels.1: The locked kitchen side room has a reward at its far end.
levels.2: Unlock the Pantry from the Kitchen with the Pantry Key and collect the charm at the back of the room.
levels.3: Take the Pantry Key from the large Kitchen enemy, unlock the pantry door, and collect the charm at the back; if supplies are low, use the ammunition lockbox there or return before the area closes.

levels.1: After opening the next wing, check its reception furniture immediately.
levels.2: Use the East Wing Keycard in Central Hall and find the figure on the reception desk in the East Wing Lobby.
levels.3: Unlock the East Wing from Central Hall, enter its lobby, and destroy the figure sitting directly ahead on the reception desk.

levels.1: The examination area has a useful item left on a clean work surface.
levels.2: In the Examination Room, collect the Hemolytic Injector from the white desk.
levels.3: Enter the Examination Room, inspect the white desk, and take the Hemolytic Injector before checking the cabinet in the corner.

levels.1: A cabinet in the examination area conceals a locked container.
levels.2: Find the safe inside the cabinet in the corner of the Examination Room.
levels.3: Open the Examination Room safe with Right 30, Left 10, Right 50 on Casual/Standard or Left 50, Right 30, Left 90 on Insanity; it contains three Antique Coins, and the later code file is not required.

levels.1: A concealed safe in the examination area holds a small group of collectibles.
levels.2: This is one of the three coins inside the cabinet safe in the Examination Room.
levels.3: Open the Examination Room safe with Right 30, Left 10, Right 50 on Casual/Standard or Left 50, Right 30, Left 90 on Insanity, then collect all three coins inside; this entry is one of them.

levels.1: A concealed safe in the examination area holds a small group of collectibles.
levels.2: This is one of the three coins inside the cabinet safe in the Examination Room.
levels.3: Open the Examination Room safe with Right 30, Left 10, Right 50 on Casual/Standard or Left 50, Right 30, Left 90 on Insanity, then collect all three coins inside; this entry is one of them.

levels.1: A concealed safe in the examination area holds a small group of collectibles.
levels.2: This is one of the three coins inside the cabinet safe in the Examination Room.
levels.3: Open the Examination Room safe with Right 30, Left 10, Right 50 on Casual/Standard or Left 50, Right 30, Left 90 on Insanity, then collect all three coins inside; this entry is one of them.

levels.1: The laboratory at the end of the next corridor has a tool on its central work surface.
levels.2: Leave the Treatment Room, go straight to the Blood Lab at the corridor's end, and take the Blood Collector from the table.
levels.3: Follow the corridor straight from the Treatment Room into the Blood Lab, then collect the Blood Collector from the table before using the nearby analyzer.

levels.1: The Blood Lab's central table has something to inspect on both sides.
levels.2: In the Blood Lab, read Blood Compound Synthesis on the opposite side of the table from the Blood Collector.
levels.3: After taking the Blood Collector, circle to the other side of the same Blood Lab table and read the Blood Compound Synthesis file.

levels.1: The Blood Lab includes a sample-and-analyzer puzzle with a useful result.
levels.2: Take the purple blood sample from the Blood Lab desk and place it in the analyzer immediately to the left.
levels.3: Insert the purple Blood Specimen into the adjacent analyzer and adjust it until every atom is red; completing the analysis unlocks Handgun Ammo and Hemolytic Injector crafting.

levels.1: On entering the next waiting area, inspect its tables before crossing the room.
levels.2: Collect the coin from the table directly ahead when you enter the Waiting Room.
levels.3: As soon as you enter the Waiting Room, approach the table in front of you and take the coin before searching behind the counter.

levels.1: The waiting area's service counter hides a document near an open container.
levels.2: Behind the Waiting Room counter, read Safe Replacements beside the open safe.
levels.3: Go behind the Waiting Room counter, inspect the document directly beside the open safe, and read it before collecting the safe's contents.

levels.1: An already-open container in the waiting area holds two collectibles.
levels.2: This is one of the two coins inside the open safe behind the Waiting Room counter.
levels.3: Go behind the Waiting Room counter, open the accessible safe beside the Safe Replacements file, and collect both coins inside; this entry is one of them.

levels.1: An already-open container in the waiting area holds two collectibles.
levels.2: This is one of the two coins inside the open safe behind the Waiting Room counter.
levels.3: Go behind the Waiting Room counter, open the accessible safe beside the Safe Replacements file, and collect both coins inside; this entry is one of them.

levels.1: Before taking the next stairs, follow the eastern corridor to its end and listen carefully.
levels.2: From the Waiting Room, follow the eastern corridor to its end and find the figure before the upstairs route.
levels.3: Follow the corridor east of the Waiting Room all the way to the dead end before the stairs, locate the moving figure there, and destroy it.

levels.1: The corridor figure has another collectible resting very close by.
levels.2: Collect the coin from the small table directly beside Mr. Raccoon #3.
levels.3: At the eastern corridor dead end, destroy Mr. Raccoon #3 and take the coin from the small table immediately beside it.

levels.1: A breakable decoration beside the previous pickup conceals another coin.
levels.2: Break the white vase beside Antique Coin #18 and collect the coin hidden inside.
levels.3: At the eastern corridor dead end, inspect the white vase next to the small table, destroy it, and pick up the coin revealed inside.

levels.1: After finishing the corridor dead end, inspect the walls along the route upstairs.
levels.2: Go upstairs from the eastern corridor dead end and collect the East Wing Map from the wall.
levels.3: From the corridor containing Mr. Raccoon #3, take the stairs up and inspect the wall at the top to collect the East Wing Map.

levels.1: The upstairs safe room has a rear space with a document on its storage furniture.
levels.2: In the upstairs safe room, enter the back room and inspect the picture on the cupboard.
levels.3: Reach the upstairs safe room, enter its rear room, and interact with Lead Researcher's Picture 2 on the cupboard before leaving.

levels.1: The upper office suite contains several records; inspect its work surfaces carefully.
levels.2: In the inner room of the Lead Researcher's Office, examine the loose Picture 1 on the desk.
levels.3: In the inner room of the Lead Researcher's Office, examine the loose Picture 1 on the desk; it is a separate file from the framed picture beside it.

levels.1: The upper office suite contains several records; inspect each displayed photograph.
levels.2: In the inner room of the Lead Researcher's Office, examine the framed Picture 3 on the desk.
levels.3: In the inner room of the Lead Researcher's Office, examine the framed Picture 3 on the desk; the loose photograph beside it registers as a separate file.

levels.1: Before leaving the upper office suite, check its less obvious storage surfaces.
levels.2: In the inner room of the Lead Researcher's Office, read the message on the separate cupboard.
levels.3: In the inner room of the Lead Researcher's Office, read the message on the separate cupboard; it is distinct from the three photograph files in this suite.

levels.1: Before leaving the upper office, look around the save point for a small tool.
levels.2: In the Lead Researcher's Office, take the Lockpick immediately left of the typewriter.
levels.3: Take the Lockpick immediately left of the Lead Researcher's Office typewriter, then use it on a locked drawer if you want to open that optional container.

levels.1: One of the upper east-side corridors holds the access item needed for blue readers.
levels.2: Take the Level 1 ID Wristband from the corridor beside the Lead Researcher's Office.
levels.3: Take the Level 1 ID Wristband from the corridor beside the Lead Researcher's Office, then use it on the blue Level 1 readers throughout the Care Center.

levels.1: A powerful enemy in the east-side return sweep carries something useful.
levels.2: Defeat the large enemy that appears after you take the Level 1 wristband, then collect its dropped charm.
levels.3: Defeat the large enemy that appears after you take the Level 1 wristband and pick up the Eye Spy Charm from its floor drop before leaving the east-wing sweep.

levels.1: Once blue readers are available, revisit previously locked rooms in the east wing.
levels.2: Use the Level 1 reader on the Closet off the Waiting Room and take the green Blood Specimen inside.
levels.3: Use the Level 1 reader on the Closet off the Waiting Room, take the green Blood Specimen, then analyze it in the Blood Lab to unlock the Med Injector and 12.7x55mm Ammo recipes.

levels.1: A newly accessible section of the laboratory contains another record.
levels.2: Use the Level 1 reader in the Blood Lab and read the journal on the table in the room beyond.
levels.3: Use the Level 1 reader in the Blood Lab, then read Victor's Journal Entry on the table; the nearby white specimen is a separate pickup.

levels.1: The newly accessible laboratory room contains more than a written record.
levels.2: Use the Level 1 reader in the Blood Lab and take the white Blood Specimen from the room beyond.
levels.3: Take the white Blood Specimen from the Level 1 room in the Blood Lab, then analyze it to unlock the Steroids and Stabilizer recipes.

levels.1: Blue-reader access also opens an inventory upgrade in the opposite wing.
levels.2: Return to the West Wing Filing Room, open its Level 1 door, and take the Hip Pouch inside.
levels.3: Open the Level 1 door in the West Wing Filing Room and take the Hip Pouch from the room beyond to add inventory space.

levels.1: Explore beyond the newly opened west-side gate and inspect posted notices.
levels.2: Open the Level 1 gate in the corridor south of the Kitchen and read the Construction Notice on the whiteboard beside the Custodian's Office.

levels.1: The conference area holds a document beyond its main room.

levels.1: The chemical opens a previously sealed puzzle box in the upper office.

levels.3: Melt the puzzle-box padlock with Corrosive, enter Star, Sun, Moon, Sun, take the Sun Quartz, and keep it for the matching recess in the Central Hall quartz door.

levels.1: A boxed organ requires careful inspection from every angle.

levels.1: The next wristband tier opens a new east-side section with documents to find.

levels.1: The Parlor's centerpiece is more than decoration.

areas.name: Care Center - Attic and Office Return

areas.note: Use the axe/hatchet routes to open blocked closets and collect the office-side pickups before the elevator.

save_backup.title: Back up your save now
save_backup.why: An elevator ahead permanently ends this return sweep. Back up before entering it.
save_backup.detail: Clear the attic, records-room closet, pantry closet, and office path first.

point_of_no_return.title: Point of no return ahead
point_of_no_return.why: Entering the Director Office elevator ends this return section.
point_of_no_return.detail: Use the return sweep to collect anything only this character can reach.

levels.1: At the start of the attic return route, sweep the first rooms before moving furniture.

levels.3: After entering the first room of the Medical Records Attic return route, read the file at the back, opposite the cupboard that opens the way forward, before leaving the room.

levels.3: Take the left-hand route from the Chairman's Office, break the closet open with the hatchet, and read the Dishwasher's Note before leaving the west-side offices.

levels.1: Revisit the records storage with a tool capable of breaking its closet.

levels.1: A pantry reward may still be available during this return sweep.

levels.3: If the Pantry is still locked, defeat the large Kitchen enemy and collect the Pantry Key; open the Pantry, then take the Connoisseur Charm from its closet.

areas.name: Care Center Basement

save_backup.title: Back up your save now
save_backup.why: A powered mechanism here permanently closes the basement and several lower-level pickups. Back up before placing all three plugs together.
save_backup.detail: Clear the workshop, furnace side office, bunkroom, processing room, map/pouch spot, and any secret setup before the third plug.

point_of_no_return.title: Point of no return ahead
point_of_no_return.why: Placing all three Joint Plugs at the holding-cell mechanism starts the basement exit path.
point_of_no_return.detail: Make the three-plug placement your final action after clearing the lower level.

items.label: File #35 - Special Directive for Raccoon City

levels.1: The lower-level route begins with new background records already in your possession.

levels.1: Search the first stretch of the lower-level tunnel before moving on.

save_backup.detail: Open all blue containers, complete apartment/gas/station side routes, buy supply-box items you want, and collect optional add-on letters before the gate.

point_of_no_return.title: Point of no return ahead
point_of_no_return.why: Using the completed Detonator on the gate ends East Raccoon City.
point_of_no_return.detail: Treat the gate detonation as the final action for this district.

items.label: File #48 - Report on the Raccoon City Incident

levels.1: A document joins your records as the city section begins.
levels.2: The report is added automatically when the East Raccoon City section begins; there is no physical pickup.
levels.3: No interaction is required: the report goes directly into the Collected Files menu when the East Raccoon City section begins, so open that menu and verify that it registered.

levels.1: Near the opening street, inspect ground-level clutter before reaching the main junction.
levels.2: From the area's starting point, walk forward a few steps and take the newspaper from the ground on the right beside the trash bags.
levels.3: Before continuing to the first intersection, move only a few steps forward, look down beside the trash bags on the right, and interact with the newspaper so it registers as a file.

levels.1: An accessible business in the early commercial block contains a hidden figure.
levels.2: At the first intersection, turn right, enter Cafe Oasis on the left before The Applegate Hotel, and look behind the counter.
levels.3: From the area's start, continue to the first intersection, turn right, and enter the first open business on the left, Cafe Oasis; go behind the counter and shoot or strike the Mr. Raccoon until it breaks.

items.label: File #50 - Orders for the Engineer Corps

levels.1: When you reach the camp, search its work areas before moving beyond it.
levels.2: Use The Applegate Hotel's revolving-door route to reach Central Camp, then read the file inside the blue tent beside the save laptop.
levels.3: Follow the route through The Applegate Hotel into Central Camp, restore power with the camp generator, and enter the blue tent containing the save laptop; read the Orders for the Engineer Corps there before leaving.

levels.1: Restoring the camp's utilities makes a new progression system available nearby.
levels.2: After activating the Central Camp generator, take the Tactical Tracker from the Supply Box beside the save laptop.
levels.3: Restore power with the Central Camp generator, then interact with the Supply Box beside the save laptop and collect the Tactical Tracker; once obtained, defeated enemies award credits that can be spent at Supply Boxes.

levels.1: Once the camp equipment is online, review the available supply inventory before spending your credits.
levels.2: After obtaining the Tactical Tracker, purchase the Silencer 9 from any Supply Box.
levels.3: Obtain the Tactical Tracker, defeat enemies to earn credits, and spend those credits on the Silencer 9 at a Supply Box; if you want to conserve ammunition while earning credits, the combat axe can be resharpened and reused indefinitely.

levels.1: Once the camp equipment is online, review the available supply inventory before spending your credits.
levels.2: After obtaining the Tactical Tracker, purchase the 990-TAC from any Supply Box.
levels.3: Obtain the Tactical Tracker, defeat enemies to earn credits, and spend those credits on the 990-TAC at a Supply Box; the combat axe can be resharpened and reused indefinitely if you want to conserve ammunition while earning credits.

levels.1: Once the camp equipment is online, review the available supply inventory before spending your credits.
levels.2: After obtaining the Tactical Tracker, purchase the Stiri REVO3 A1 from any Supply Box.
levels.3: Obtain the Tactical Tracker, defeat enemies to earn credits, and spend those credits on the Stiri REVO3 A1 at a Supply Box; the combat axe can be resharpened and reused indefinitely if you want to conserve ammunition while earning credits.

levels.1: Once the camp equipment is online, review its defensive upgrades before spending your credits.
levels.2: After obtaining the Tactical Tracker, purchase Body Armor Lv. 1 from any Supply Box.
levels.3: Obtain the Tactical Tracker, earn credits by defeating enemies, and purchase Body Armor Lv. 1 from a Supply Box; buying it also makes Body Armor Lv. 2 available for purchase.

levels.1: A second defensive upgrade becomes available after buying the first.
levels.2: Purchase Body Armor Lv. 1 from a Supply Box, then purchase Body Armor Lv. 2 when it appears in the inventory.
levels.3: After obtaining the Tactical Tracker, earn enough credits to buy Body Armor Lv. 1 first; return to a Supply Box after that purchase and spend additional credits on Body Armor Lv. 2.

levels.1: Once the camp equipment is online, check its capacity upgrades before spending your credits.
levels.2: After obtaining the Tactical Tracker, purchase the Case Upgrade (8x13) from any Supply Box.
levels.3: Obtain the Tactical Tracker, defeat enemies to earn credits, and purchase the Case Upgrade from a Supply Box to expand the case to 8x13.

levels.1: As you climb through the warehouse beyond the camp, inspect its dark upper rooms.
levels.2: Raise the rear Central Camp shutter, cross the Logistics Warehouse, and take the Cedarbrook Apartments Key from the wall beside the door in the dark second-floor room.
levels.3: Press the red wall button at the back of Central Camp to raise the shutter, enter the Logistics Warehouse, and shoot down the hanging crates to create a route upward; upon reaching the dark room on the second floor, collect the key hanging on the wall beside the door.

levels.1: Before leaving the warehouse roof, check its colored equipment containers.
levels.2: On the Logistics Warehouse roof, turn left and take the Distributor from the yellow box.
levels.3: Climb onto the Logistics Warehouse roof, turn left immediately, open the yellow box, and collect the Distributor; keep it for combination with a later receiver component.

levels.1: From the high warehouse roof, scan the distant wrecked vehicles with a scope.
levels.2: From the Logistics Warehouse roof, face west toward the highway and aim at the van in front of the delivery truck.
levels.3: After collecting the Distributor, turn around toward the rooftop elevator and face west toward the highway; locate the van directly in front of a delivery truck, then use a scoped sniper rifle to shoot the Mr. Raccoon sitting on top of that van.

levels.1: Below the camp, search the side rooms along the underground parking route.
levels.2: Use the Cedarbrook Apartments Key on the gate beside the Central Camp elevator, go downstairs through the right-hand door, and check the room on the left near the stealth-training area.
levels.3: Unlock the gate beside the Central Camp elevator with the Cedarbrook Apartments Key, descend the stairs, and enter the door on the right; when you reach the first stealth-training enemy, enter the room on the left and shoot or strike the Mr. Raccoon on the box.

levels.1: The flooded garage has a readable utility notice near its secured equipment.
levels.2: In the next flooded section of the Underground Parking Garage, turn left and inspect the red-lit box to the right of the gate.
levels.3: From the previous figure, enter the next parking-garage section, turn left into the flooded area, and approach the gate; interact with the red-lit box on the gate's right side to register Battery Storage Locations.

levels.1: A required power component is hidden in a far room of the flooded garage.
levels.2: From the red-lit file box, turn around, climb over the ladder, and take Battery #1 from the wall in the small room at the garage's northwest corner.
levels.3: After reading Battery Storage Locations, turn around 180 degrees, climb over the ladder, and cross the flooded garage to its northwest corner; enter the small room there and remove Battery #1 from its wall mount.

levels.1: A weapon case shares one of the flooded garage's small utility rooms.
levels.2: In the same northwest flooded-garage room as Battery #1, open the silver box.
levels.3: After removing Battery #1 from the wall, inspect the silver box in that same small room, open it, and take the Gal SMG.

levels.1: After descending into the sewage facility, watch the main route for a reusable mechanism part.
levels.2: After dropping into the Sewage Facility, pick up the Valve Handwheel from the path ahead.
levels.3: Follow the Sewage Facility route until the drop, collect the Valve Handwheel from the path after landing, and keep it for the mechanism directly across the next room.

levels.1: A second power component becomes accessible after reconfiguring an upper route.
levels.2: Insert the Valve Handwheel into the mechanism on the opposite door, turn it fully to form an upper bridge, and cross to Battery #2.
levels.3: Place the Valve Handwheel into the mechanism on the door directly across the room and turn it all the way; this creates a walkable bridge along the upper level, which you must cross to reach and collect Battery #2.

levels.1: Once the flooded-garage gate is powered, the route supplies keys for nearby blue containers.
levels.2: Install both batteries in the flooded-garage gate, proceed forward and left, and continue until the BSAA Container Keys are added automatically.
levels.3: Insert Battery #1 and Battery #2 into the flooded-garage gate, pass through it, and follow the route forward and left; the BSAA Container Keys are granted automatically rather than picked up from the floor, and they open all three large blue BSAA Containers in this area.

levels.1: Near the apartment entrance, search the open cargo containers.
levels.2: After receiving the BSAA Container Keys, turn immediately left and read the Inventory List inside the open container in front of Cedarbrook Apartments.
levels.3: As soon as the route grants the BSAA Container Keys, look immediately left before entering Cedarbrook Apartments, step inside the open cargo container, and interact with the Inventory List so it registers.

levels.1: Check the parked vehicles around the apartment approach.
levels.2: Beside the open container holding File #52, look for the figure on the driver's seat of the bus.
levels.3: From the open container containing the Inventory List, enter the adjacent bus, find the Mr. Raccoon on the driver's seat, and shoot or strike it until it breaks.

levels.1: A reusable crank is found while clearing the lower apartments.
levels.2: On the first floor of Cedarbrook Apartments, follow the lower-floor route to the crank-operated door and collect the Rusty Crank there.
levels.3: Collect the Rusty Crank while progressing through the bottom floor of Cedarbrook Apartments, then carry it back upstairs and use it on the balcony gate; it can also open an optional route to consumables in the Sewage Facility.

levels.1: After using the crank upstairs, search the upper apartment interior before taking the stairs down.
levels.2: Use the Rusty Crank on the upstairs balcony gate, climb the next ladder, turn right into the upper floor, and check the open refrigerator at the back near the stairwell.
levels.3: Return upstairs with the Rusty Crank, use it on the balcony gate, and climb the ladder beyond it; turn right into the upper apartment floor, go right toward the stairwell without descending, continue to the back, and shoot or strike the Mr. Raccoon inside the open refrigerator.

levels.1: At the far end of the apartment rooftop route, inspect the colored equipment boxes.
levels.2: On the Cedarbrook Apartments roof, open the yellow box at the far end of the route and take the Broken Signal Receiver.
levels.3: Cross the Cedarbrook Apartments rooftop route to its far end, open the yellow box, and collect the Broken Signal Receiver; combine it with the Distributor in your inventory to create the Distributor & Broken Signal Receiver.

levels.1: Before leaving the apartment roof, check the work surfaces beside the key-item container.
levels.2: On the Cedarbrook Apartments roof, read the Engineer Corps Note immediately to the right of the yellow receiver box.
levels.3: Take the Broken Signal Receiver from the rooftop's far-end yellow box, then turn immediately right and read the Engineer Corps Note before leaving.

levels.1: Explore the gas-station interior carefully before restoring power outside.
levels.2: Shoot down the ladder across the street from Cedarbrook Apartments, climb it, drop into the Gas Station, and check the metal shelving inside.
levels.3: On the street opposite the Cedarbrook Apartments entrance, shoot the raised ladder to lower it, climb up, and follow the route down into the Gas Station; find the Mr. Raccoon on a metal shelf inside and shoot or strike it until it breaks.

levels.1: The station grounds contain fuel equipment needed for nearby machinery.
levels.2: Follow the route through the Gas Station and take the Gas Can beside the generator.
levels.3: Collect the Gas Can beside the generator after passing through the Gas Station, carry it to the filling point at the back of the station's main yard to turn it into the Gas Can with Fuel, then return and use it on the generator where the empty can was found.

levels.1: Search the elevated roadside routes for the first locked blue container.
levels.2: On the main road's eastern end between the Gas Station and Cedarbrook Apartments, climb behind the truck and unlock the large blue container with the BSAA Container Keys.
levels.3: Follow the main road east from the Gas Station toward Cedarbrook Apartments, climb the route behind the truck at the road's end, and use the BSAA Container Keys on the large blue container; all three containers appear on the map when you approach them, and the weapon inside this one can still be purchased later if it does not fit in your inventory.

levels.1: Make room before opening the first locked blue container; it holds a large weapon.
levels.2: Unlock BSAA Container #1 on the main road's eastern end, between the Gas Station and Cedarbrook Apartments, to obtain the Marksman 1A.
levels.3: At the main road's eastern end, climb behind the truck and use the BSAA Container Keys on Container #1. Take the Marksman 1A; if the case is full, later Supply Boxes will sell it.

levels.1: A newly opened road shortcut has something hidden below it.
levels.2: At the west end of the main road, activate the large crane shortcut and look down to the left while crossing it toward Central Camp.
levels.3: At the main road's western end, activate the large crane to form the Central Camp shortcut and start crossing it. Aim down-left into the exposed sewage pipe and destroy the figure inside.

levels.1: Revisit the camp's large blue container after obtaining its matching keys.
levels.2: In Central Camp, use the BSAA Container Keys on the large blue container in the corner beside the tent.
levels.3: Backtrack to Central Camp, locate the large blue container in the corner beside the tent, and unlock it with the BSAA Container Keys; take the Repair Kit from inside before leaving.

levels.1: A component inside one locked blue container repairs an assembled signal device.
levels.2: Open BSAA Container #2 in the corner of Central Camp beside the tent and take the Repair Kit.
levels.3: Use the BSAA Container Keys on the large blue container beside the Central Camp tent, collect the Repair Kit inside, and combine it with the Distributor & Broken Signal Receiver in your inventory.

levels.1: A subterranean route from the main road passes through a place worth searching seat by seat.
levels.2: Use the fueled generator at the large crane between the Gas Station and Central Camp, enter the opened route, descend underground, and check the passenger seats in the train compartment.
levels.3: Use the Gas Can with Fuel on the generator beside the large crane on the road between the Gas Station and Central Camp, pass through the newly opened gate, and descend the ladder; follow the underground route into the train compartment, then shoot or strike the Mr. Raccoon sitting on a passenger seat.

levels.1: After the underground station loop returns you near the city's opening streets, search outside the nearby buildings.
levels.2: Continue through Ridgewood Station until you emerge near the area's starting point, then open the large blue container outside The Applegate Hotel.
levels.3: From the train compartment, continue through Ridgewood Station until the route returns you to the opening streets, locate the large blue container outside The Applegate Hotel, and unlock it with the BSAA Container Keys to collect the charm inside.

levels.1: A late blue-container reward improves unscoped firepower.
levels.2: Open BSAA Container #3 outside The Applegate Hotel after returning through Ridgewood Station.
levels.3: Follow Ridgewood Station back to the area's opening streets and unlock the large blue container outside The Applegate Hotel with the BSAA Container Keys; take the BSAA Emblem Charm inside, whose firepower bonus applies only while a scope is not equipped.

levels.1: A powered rooftop route from the camp leads to an elevated building with a hidden figure.
levels.2: Return to Central Camp, take the elevator to the roof, climb down the right-hand ladder, power the generator, ride the zipline to Willis Tower, and check the shelf in the room beyond the upstairs sofas.
levels.3: Return through Ridgewood Station's second revolving door to Central Camp. Ride the camp elevator upward, descend the right-hand rooftop ladder, fuel the generator, press its red button, and zipline to Willis Tower. From the landing, go upstairs, turn right, follow the sofas into the next room, and break the shelf figure.

levels.1: Search the far end of the tower route for a component that completes an existing device.
levels.2: At the end of Willis Tower, collect the Relay and combine it with the other detonator parts.
levels.3: Follow the Willis Tower route to its end, take the Relay, then open your inventory and combine it with the other detonator components to create the finished Detonator.

levels.1: The hotel lobby contains optional reading before you take its main route.
levels.2: Before using The Applegate Hotel's revolving-door route, take the letter from the couch in the lobby.
levels.3: Enter The Applegate Hotel lobby before committing to the revolving-door route, inspect the couch, and collect the optional letter from its seat so it registers.

levels.1: Explore the gas-station shop shelves before leaving the city.
levels.2: Inside the Gas Station store, take the letter from one of the shop shelves.
levels.3: During the Gas Station sweep, enter the store area, inspect its shelving, and interact with the optional letter before leaving the building.

areas.name: Raccoon City Center and R.P.D.
areas.location_cue: A city-center approach into the police station main hall, west office, operations room, reception ladder route, S.T.A.R.S. office, and library.
areas.note: R.P.D. route with a small exterior pickup first and several clue-linked office/library items.

save_backup.title: Back up your save now
save_backup.why: Entering and later leaving the station can permanently close nearby pickups. Back up before the station gate and again before using the library/shutter route onward.
save_backup.detail: Read the clue files before hunting the hidden key, and clear the library before using the shutters.

point_of_no_return.title: Point of no return ahead
point_of_no_return.why: The station gate closes the exterior plaza, and the shutter route out of the main hall moves you away from the station sweep.
point_of_no_return.detail: Complete plaza, west office, operations room, S.T.A.R.S. office, locker, and library pickups first.

levels.1: When city-center travel returns to foot, search the debris around the largest wrecks.
levels.2: At the start of the on-foot city-center route, turn slightly left and look in the rubble in front of the destroyed tanker.
levels.3: As soon as the city-center route returns you to foot, angle slightly left toward the destroyed tanker, find the Mr. Raccoon in the rubble directly in front of it, and shoot or strike it until it breaks.

levels.1: Early in the station interior, check the supply surfaces around the central save area.
levels.2: In the R.P.D. Main Hall, read the report on the box opposite the save point.
levels.3: After entering the R.P.D. Main Hall, face away from the save point, locate the report on the box directly opposite it, and interact with the document until it registers.

levels.1: Search the desks in the first offices adjoining the station's save point.
levels.2: In the West Office beside the save point, read the file on the first desk to the right.
levels.3: Enter the West Office next to the save point, turn toward the first desk on the right, and interact with Top Secret Operation before searching deeper into the room.

levels.1: A damaged ground-floor room hides a figure within its debris.
levels.2: In the Operations Room, look into the rubble behind the wooden barricade on the room's left side.
levels.3: Move to the left side of the Operations Room, aim into the rubble behind the wooden barricade, and shoot the concealed Mr. Raccoon until it breaks.

levels.1: Inspect wall displays while sweeping the station's ground-floor work rooms.
levels.2: In the Operations Room, interact with the Record of Events on the chalkboard.
levels.3: Approach the chalkboard in the Operations Room and inspect the Record of Events directly on its surface, making sure the file registers before leaving.

levels.1: An upstairs office reached from Reception holds an examinable clue among its storage furniture.
levels.2: At Reception, shoot down and climb the ladder, follow the upper corridor past the Library, enter the S.T.A.R.S. Office, and inspect the shelf on the right.
levels.3: Go south from the Operations Room to Reception, shoot down the ladder above the locked shutter, and climb to the second floor; continue straight through the corridor without entering the Library, enter the S.T.A.R.S. Office at the corridor's end, take the clue from the shelf on the right, and rotate it to read the note.

levels.1: The small side office adjoining the upstairs team room has a file requiring an extra interaction.
levels.2: In the S.T.A.R.S. Office, enter the small side office on the left and open the desk drawer.
levels.3: Enter the small side office to the left of the S.T.A.R.S. Office entrance, interact with the desk drawer to open it, then wait a moment for the Library Card to appear and collect it.

levels.1: Personal effects in the upstairs office conceal another clue.
levels.2: In the S.T.A.R.S. Office, inspect the brown jacket hanging between the desks opposite the entrance.
levels.3: Stand inside the S.T.A.R.S. Office and face the wall directly opposite its entrance, interact with the brown jacket hanging between the desks, then rotate the recovered file to read the clue.

levels.1: Check every desk in the upstairs office before moving on to the Library.
levels.2: In the S.T.A.R.S. Office, read Barry's To Do List on the leftmost desk.
levels.3: Move to the leftmost desk in the S.T.A.R.S. Office, interact with Barry's To Do List on its surface, and make sure the file registers before leaving.

levels.1: A coded case in an upstairs side room can be opened before its formal clue appears.
levels.2: In the locker room at the left corner of the S.T.A.R.S. Office, inspect the locked briefcase.
levels.3: In the locker room at the S.T.A.R.S. Office's left corner, set the briefcase to RRR. It opens before File #61 is found; Power Shades lets rounds pass through any number of targets and boosts the cylinder's last shot.

levels.1: Two related clue files make a hidden key appear back on the ground floor.
levels.2: After reading both Scavenger Hunt clue files, return to the Operations Room, climb the crate beside the chalkboard, and look toward the ceiling-mounted television.
levels.3: Read both Scavenger Hunt clue files in the S.T.A.R.S. Office first, because the Locker Key does not appear until both have been opened; return downstairs to the Operations Room, climb onto the crate in front of the corner chalkboard, turn toward the television fixed to the ceiling, and collect the newly visible key.

levels.1: The scavenger-hunt key opens a marked locker elsewhere in the station.
levels.2: Return to the West Office and use the Locker Key on the locker marked with an exclamation point on the map.
levels.3: Use the Locker Key on the marked West Office locker, take the S.T.A.R.S. Emblem Charm, and rotate the zoo tickets to view their backs and complete the clue sequence; the charm increases firepower at the cost of greater aiming sway.

levels.1: Search the Library floor before exploring its upper walkways.
levels.2: Climb the Reception ladder to the second floor, enter the Library through the door on the right, and take the Mechanic Jack from the floor in the room's northern section.
levels.3: From Reception, shoot down and climb the ladder above the locked shutter, then use the right-hand door to enter the Library; search the northern part of the ground floor and collect the Mechanic Jack lying beside the central shelving.

levels.1: Books can obscure a figure in the Library's central shelving.
levels.2: On the north-facing side of the tall central Library bookshelf, aim at the second bottom-row shelf from the left beside the Mechanic Jack.
levels.3: Beside the Mechanic Jack, face the Library's central tall bookshelf from its north side. Aim along the bottom row at the second compartment from the left and shoot the figure behind the books.

levels.1: After fully reading the files in the nearby office, recheck the Library bookshelves for a newly available entry.
levels.2: After reading all four S.T.A.R.S. Office files, go upstairs in the Library, cross left toward the locked wooden door, and inspect the brown leather book in the shelf to its right.
levels.3: Open these four S.T.A.R.S. Office files first: (1) Barry's To Do List; (2) Scavenger Hunt - Clue 1; (3) Scavenger Hunt - Clue 2; and (4) Library Card. The target book will not appear earlier. Go to the Library's upper floor, follow the left walkway to the locked wooden door, open the brown leather book on the shelf beside it, and examine the Photograph.

levels.1: Before leaving Reception, scan for a small optional visual reference.
levels.2: In the R.P.D. Reception area, look for the small hidden figure or reference before finishing the station sweep.
levels.3: Complete a deliberate visual sweep of Reception, checking its low sightlines and side angles, and confirm the small hidden figure or reference before leaving the station.

levels.1: The west-side corridor hides a small optional reference at a low angle.
levels.2: In the R.P.D. West Corridor, check the corridor corners and low sightlines for the small hidden figure or reference.
levels.3: Walk the full West Corridor slowly, inspect each corner at floor level, and visually confirm the small hidden figure or reference before leaving the station.

levels.1: Before leaving the Operations Room, inspect its rubble from several angles for an optional reference.
levels.2: In the Operations Room, look around the rubble and side angles for the small hidden figure or reference.
levels.3: Circle the Operations Room rubble and inspect it from the side rather than only from the main path, then visually confirm the hidden figure or reference before using the station exit route.

levels.1: The station's upper floor has another optional reference around its stairwells.
levels.2: On the R.P.D. second floor, inspect the stairs outside the chief-office side of the building.
levels.3: Reach the second floor and search the area immediately around the stairs outside the chief-office side, checking the nearby surfaces and low angles until you visually confirm the Mr. Charlie Doll Base.

levels.1: Slow down around the desks and display pieces in the upstairs office.
levels.2: Inspect the beret and medical bag displayed inside the S.T.A.R.S. Office.
levels.3: Enter the second-floor S.T.A.R.S. Office and examine the beret and medical bag rather than crossing directly to the objective. Both are retained props associated with that office's earlier occupants.

levels.1: A card found upstairs opens a small library discovery.
levels.2: After taking the Library Card from the S.T.A.R.S. Office, inspect the book on the library's upper level.
levels.3: Carry the Library Card to the upper library walkway and use it on the eligible book. Open the book to reveal and inspect the hidden photograph; this is separate from merely collecting the card.

areas.name: Orphanage
areas.location_cue: Inside an old building route that leads through a lower chapel-like area and then into a white lab corridor with a meeting room.
areas.note: Short stealth/puzzle route. The meeting-room remote is the lock.

save_backup.title: Back up your save now
save_backup.why: Using a meeting-room device permanently closes this building route. Back up before using it.
save_backup.detail: Collect the lower-room and lab-corridor files first.

point_of_no_return.title: Point of no return ahead
point_of_no_return.why: Using the remote in the meeting room ends this route.
point_of_no_return.detail: Clear the chapel side room and lab room before touching the remote.

levels.1: After operating the chapel mechanism, search the side chamber's containers before continuing.
levels.2: Once the Underground Chapel's wall lever has been operated, pass through the side door it opened and lift the right-hand coffin lid.
levels.3: Operate the wall lever in the Underground Chapel, pass through the side door that opens, and approach the pair of black coffins immediately inside; open the coffin on the right, take the Toe Tag, rotate it, and read the back so the file registers.

levels.1: Early in the laboratory section, check the first few side rooms before moving deeper.
levels.2: In the white laboratory corridor, enter the first green-lit door on the right; the file is directly ahead.
levels.3: In the white laboratory corridor, enter the first green-lit door on the right and collect Series 60 Results directly ahead before continuing.

levels.1: Before leaving the early laboratory room, sweep its work surfaces carefully.
levels.2: In the same laboratory room as the previous file, collect the notebook from the desk in the back-right corner.
levels.3: In the white laboratory corridor, enter the first green-lit door on the right, then collect the New Researcher's Notebook from the desk in that room's back-right corner.

areas.name: Raccoon City Side Street
areas.location_cue: Back outside the station, around an upper-hall bench, parking garage, gun shop, alley, train, and cave-like path.
areas.note: Short city-side route with optional garage/gun-shop pickups and a plant-seedling sequence.

save_backup.title: Back up your save now
save_backup.why: Several pickups and a grouped destruction set can be permanently missed before the route moves underground. Back up before leaving the street/gun-shop path.
save_backup.detail: Clear the upper bench, garage container, gun shop shelf, alley window, optional add-on letter reward, and every seedling in the train/cave route.

point_of_no_return.title: Point of no return ahead
point_of_no_return.why: Descending/continuing through the underground route after the street sequence closes the side-street sweep.
point_of_no_return.detail: Do not leave the street route until the current-area counts are clear.

levels.1: When returning to a familiar large interior, check nearby seating before moving on.
levels.2: On returning to the R.P.D. Main Hall, collect the pamphlet from a bench on the eastern upper floor before leaving the building.
levels.3: As soon as the R.P.D. Main Hall route resumes, turn back toward the eastern upper-floor bench and collect the pamphlet before taking the exit path.

levels.1: An optional detour shortly after reaching the street hides a useful charm near illuminated storage.
levels.2: After leaving the R.P.D., go left into the dark Parking Garage and collect the charm from the ground to the right of the illuminated open container.
levels.3: After leaving the R.P.D., descend into the optional Parking Garage on the left, approach the illuminated open container, and collect the charm from the ground on its right; it boosts mid-range firepower while reducing close-range power.

levels.1: The same optional parking detour contains a weapon part inside an obvious container.
levels.2: In the dark Parking Garage left of the R.P.D. exit, collect the scope from inside the illuminated open container.
levels.3: Enter the optional Parking Garage left of the R.P.D. exit and search the illuminated open container for the Silver Finish Scope.

levels.1: Before continuing along the shop-lined street, recheck the weapon displays inside the accessible gun shop.
levels.2: Enter the gun shop from the main road and, once the interior route opens, turn around to take the shotgun from the shelf behind the door.

levels.1: Use the prompted hatchet finisher repeatedly.

levels.3: Weaken ordinary zombies until the close-combat finishing prompt appears, then use the hatchet prompt. Repeat for three separate zombie kills; they do not need to occur together. Reward: 200 CP.

levels.1: Make one purchase through Leon's field shop.
levels.2: Buy any item from a supply box.
levels.3: Open a supply box as Leon, choose any affordable ammo, recovery item, weapon, or upgrade, and confirm the Credit purchase. Simply browsing the catalog does not count. Reward: 200 CP.

levels.1: Invest Credits in one weapon statistic.
levels.2: Purchase any weapon upgrade from a supply box.
levels.3: At a Leon supply box, open the tuning tab, select any owned weapon, buy one power, capacity, reload, or related upgrade, and confirm the weapon's stat changes. Reward: 200 CP.

levels.1: Watch for a short interrupt prompt during the highway sequence.
levels.2: Shoot the adjacent attacker when the red warning marker appears during the highway ride.
levels.3: During the highway chase, keep the weapon ready. When the attacker draws alongside and a red arrow appears overhead, fire immediately to cancel the incoming move. Missing this window requires reloading a pre-highway save or trying on another run. Reward: 200 CP.

levels.1: Leon must personally produce every recipe result at least once.
levels.2: Learn Leon's full recipe list and craft one of each possible item.
levels.3: Reserve gunpowder and parts until all nine Leon recipes are visible, then craft each distinct result once. Check the record after every craft; pickups and shop purchases do not substitute for crafting. Reward: 200 CP.

levels.1: Line up a crowd before firing the high-penetration weapon.
levels.2: Kill at least three enemies with one Requiem shot.
levels.3: Group three weakened ordinary enemies in a narrow street or corridor, align their torsos or legs, and fire one Requiem round through the line. All three deaths must result from that single projectile. Reward: 500 CP.

levels.1: A tongue strike creates a special parry opportunity.
levels.2: Sever a Licker's extended tongue with a hatchet parry.
levels.3: Keep a usable hatchet equipped near a Licker, maintain enough distance to bait the tongue lash, and perfect-parry as the tongue reaches Leon. The sever animation must occur; an ordinary body parry does not count. Reward: 500 CP.

levels.1: An optional heavy enemy patrols the kitchen wing.
levels.2: Defeat the large kitchen patrol before leaving the Care Center.
levels.3: In the West Wing Kitchen area, use the doorway and furniture to limit the heavy patrol's turns, stagger it with focused shots, and finish it. Loot the dropped key and charm, then verify the record before the area's point of no return. Reward: 500 CP.

levels.1: Two sound-producing infected are optional combat targets in separate Care Center rooms.
levels.2: Defeat both singer-type infected before leaving the Care Center.
levels.3: Kill the singer in the Bar/Lounge and the one in the Conference Room during the same campaign completion file. Prioritize each when its song begins and verify the pair counter reaches two before departure. Reward: 500 CP.

levels.1: Grace can defeat one heavy East Wing patrol instead of only avoiding it.
levels.2: Defeat a Chunk while controlling Grace.
levels.3: Use narrow doorways to control the East Wing heavy patrol, retreat between shots, and finish it as Grace. Hemolytic tools or Requiem can shorten the fight. Confirm the record before leaving the building. Reward: 1000 CP.

levels.1: An enraged infected can damage another infected nearby.
levels.2: Cause one zombie to attack another in the hospital wards.
levels.3: In a ward containing at least two zombies, throw a bottle to enrage one while the other stands close to its swing path. Keep repositioning until its attack damages the second zombie; player damage between them does not count. Reward: 500 CP.

levels.1: Enemy defeats accumulate across playthroughs.
levels.2: Defeat 300 enemies in total.
levels.3: Continue defeating enemies across campaign and extra-mode attempts until the global Challenges counter reaches 300. If short after other requirements, use dense Casual combat sections rather than resetting collectible progress. Reward: 1500 CP.

levels.1: A complete city sweep includes every small plant growth.
levels.2: Destroy all nine Plant 43 seedlings before leaving Raccoon City.
levels.3: Use the nine individually listed seedling entries in the Side Street area, destroy each growth, and confirm the challenge counter is complete before the next irreversible transition. Reward: 500 CP.

levels.1: Every combination safe belongs to one shared completion record.
levels.2: Open all five campaign safes.
levels.3: Open the Bar/Lounge, Examination Room, Care Center Basement, ARK Sterilization Chamber, and ARK Monitor Control Room safes. Use each area's level-3 code and verify the global counter reaches 5/5. Reward: 500 CP.

levels.1: Large marked containers in the city share a completion counter.
levels.2: Open all four BSAA containers during the Raccoon City sweep.
levels.3: Collect the BSAA keys, open every marked shipping container in the city, and verify 4/4 before leaving. The pack lists each container and its required key route separately. Reward: 500 CP.

levels.1: Every readable document contributes to a persistent file counter.
levels.2: Read all 75 main-story files.
levels.3: Open every file listed across the location areas and scroll each to register it. Check Challenges for 75/75; file progress persists across playthroughs, but the area backup is faster than waiting for another full route. Reward: 3000 CP.

levels.1: The full commemorative-figure set unlocks this record and another bonus.
levels.2: Destroy all 25 Mr. Raccoon memoriams.
levels.3: Use the 25 figure entries and both Raccoon Roundup maps to destroy every memoriam. Confirm 25/25; this also makes Advanced Tuning available in Special Content. Reward: 2000 CP.

levels.1: A dedicated post-clear route has a strict results-screen timer.
levels.2: Choose Release and finish the campaign in under four hours.
levels.3: Run Casual with cutscenes skipped, optional rooms ignored, and bonus weapons enabled. Monitor Pause > Challenges rather than real time, select Release at the late prompt, and reach the results screen below 4:00:00. This also unlocks Infinite Ribbon. Reward: 20000 CP.

levels.1: Leon has a cumulative currency-earning record.
levels.2: Earn 200,000 Credits across Leon sections.
levels.3: Equip the Tactical Tracker or its modded bonus version and defeat enemies while controlling Leon until the global earned-Credits counter reaches 200,000. Spending Credits does not reduce progress. Reward: 3000 CP.

levels.1: The Blood Collector has a large cumulative gathering counter.
levels.2: Collect 5,000 infected-blood microsamples.
levels.3: Use the Blood Collector on every available source and convert Transfusion Bags until Pause > Challenges reaches 5,000 collected. This is cumulative; do it on a collector-enabled run, never during Minimalist. Reward: 10000 CP.

levels.1: Purchased models still need to be opened once.
levels.2: Buy and view every model in Bonuses.
levels.3: Spend CP until all 44 Model entries are unlocked, then open each unseen entry so no new marker remains. The check occurs on viewing, not merely purchasing. Reward: 1000 CP.

levels.1: Purchased gallery art still needs to be opened once.
levels.2: Buy and view every concept-art entry in Bonuses.
levels.3: Spend CP until all 56 Concept Art entries are unlocked, then open each unseen image so no new marker remains. Prioritize gameplay bonuses before this CP sink. Reward: 1000 CP.

levels.1: One manual healing input invalidates this record for the run.
levels.2: Finish a campaign without using any Herb or Med Injector.
levels.3: On Casual, remap or avoid the quick-heal input, never consume Herbs or Med Injectors, and check that the challenge counter stays at zero. Automatic recovery and forced health resets are allowed. Combine with Speed Demon and Minimalist for an efficient run. Reward: 35000 CP.

levels.1: Keep the Blood Collector use counter at zero for an entire clear.
levels.2: Finish a campaign without Grace using the Blood Collector.
levels.3: On the Casual triple-challenge run, leave the Blood Collector uncollected or store it immediately and never activate it, analyze with it, gather blood, or craft from it. Check Pause > Challenges for zero uses through the results screen. Reward: 35000 CP.

levels.1: A multi-run secret depends on a precise first-run setup and a carried pair later.
levels.2: Prepare the hidden doll on one run, finish with it, then use it with its paired item at the research-office symbol device on a later run.
levels.3: On the setup run, wait 15 real minutes before stopping the Processing wheel, let the grinder kill every reanimated body, verify the 'ton of blood' message, flush the first-floor toilet eight times, and collect Marie's Doll at the Collection & Testing stairs. Finish while retaining the doll. On a later run, carry Marie's Doll and Emily to the Lead Researcher's Office device. Enter row 1: Sun, Sun, Star; row 2: Sun, Moon, Star; row 3: Sun, Moon, Sun; row 4: Moon, Star, Moon. Reward: 20000 CP.

areas.name: Leon Must Die Forever Ranks
areas.location_cue: The Extra Games menu after a campaign clear and the free mode update is installed.
areas.note: Each successful cycle raises the next run's Forever Rank; there is no campaign S-rank requirement.

levels.1: A successful extra-mode cycle unlocks a tougher rank and permanent preparation options.
levels.2: In Extra Games, complete Leon Must Die Forever on Forever Rank 1.
levels.3: Start Rank 1, use red doors to choose a route, gather weapon chests and enhancers, extend time with gold or colored spinners, and defeat the final target before the timer expires. Dying restarts the cycle. The clear unlocks Wolf Mode loadout and Surveyor enhancer.
