levels.1: A separate-mode record rewards experimenting with routes, ranks, and enhancer builds.
levels.2: Let three LMDF attempts end in failure.
levels.3: Start the mode and fail three runs; timeout or death counts. Verify the failure counter reaches three. Reward: 1000 CP.

levels.1: A separate-mode record rewards experimenting with routes, ranks, and enhancer builds.
levels.2: Discard any carried weapon during an LMDF run.
levels.3: Open the case during a run, select a weapon rather than ammo, and choose Discard. Do this only after another usable weapon is secured. Reward: 1000 CP.

levels.1: A separate-mode record rewards experimenting with routes, ranks, and enhancer builds.
levels.2: Refine 50 enhancers across LMDF attempts.
levels.3: Fill the Cloud 9 gauge through kills, choose enhancer refinements whenever available, and continue across runs until the cumulative counter reaches 50. Reward: 3000 CP.

levels.1: A separate-mode record rewards experimenting with routes, ranks, and enhancer builds.
levels.2: Defeat 30 time-extending gold or colored spinners.
levels.3: Shoot every Midas and Aurora Spinner encountered; their time bonuses help the run and the cumulative challenge accepts either type until 30 total. Reward: 3000 CP.

levels.1: A separate-mode record rewards experimenting with routes, ranks, and enhancer builds.
levels.2: Use every distinct glowing red door across the mode's maps.
levels.3: Take alternate routes on repeated attempts and enter each unique red door at least once. Check the challenge after every new route until all doors register. Reward: 5000 CP.

levels.1: A separate-mode record rewards experimenting with routes, ranks, and enhancer builds.
levels.2: Defeat the city tyrant target on Rank 2 or higher.
levels.3: On Forever Rank 2+, route through the city encounter and defeat its tyrant before continuing. A lower-rank kill does not count. Reward: 10000 CP.

levels.1: A separate-mode record rewards experimenting with routes, ranks, and enhancer builds.
levels.2: Defeat the repository commander target on Rank 2 or higher.
levels.3: On Forever Rank 2+, choose the ARK route, prepare a high-rank weapon, and defeat the commander encounter before leaving that stage. Reward: 9000 CP.

levels.1: A separate-mode record rewards experimenting with routes, ranks, and enhancer builds.
levels.2: Complete the mode's final target on Rank 3 or higher.
levels.3: On Forever Rank 3+, preserve enough time and ammunition for the final door, then defeat the closing target and reach the clear screen. Reward: 35000 CP.

levels.1: A separate-mode record rewards experimenting with routes, ranks, and enhancer builds.
levels.2: Meet both a survival-time and defeat counter before the final target on Rank 3+.
levels.3: On Rank 3 or higher, remain in the run for at least 40 minutes and defeat at least 110 enemies before entering the final encounter; verify both live counters first. Reward: 15000 CP.

levels.1: A separate-mode record rewards experimenting with routes, ranks, and enhancer builds.
levels.2: Finish Rank 3+ without increasing enhancer-slot capacity.
levels.3: On Rank 3 or higher, never collect or use a Slot Expansion. Complete the entire run with the starting slot count and defeat the final target. Reward: 15000 CP.

levels.3: On Rank 3 or higher, stack single-hit damage enhancers and a high-rank firearm, then deal at least 5,000 damage to the tyrant with one hit. RPG-7 damage is excluded. Reward: 15000 CP.

levels.1: Challenge Points can permanently improve future extra-mode attempts.

levels.3: Spend the mode's CP on every LMDF entry: starting recovery, case capacity, spinner options, ability upgrades, Hellblaze, and the once-per-run RPG-7. In the loadout menu, verify No-Frills plus the rank rewards: Wolf Mode (1), Turbo GT (2), Hot Fuzz (3), and Axe-orcist (5).

save_backup.title: Back up your save now

save_backup.detail: Only use this card after the first full clear and continued-run setup.

point_of_no_return.why: This secret cannot be fully completed from a single fresh playthrough state.
point_of_no_return.detail: The first-run route only prepares it; completion happens on a later/continued route.

levels.1: A continuation-only secret uses the setup items prepared earlier; revisit a familiar research puzzle.
